source: Hand-authored. Ids are stable identifiers referenced by solutions/runbook-notes.json and the generated 01-solutions runbooks; never rename an id.

aibast_patterns.title: Evidence-First Release Gate
aibast_patterns.summary: Trace each one-pager promise through implemented behavior, isolated transcripts, static demos, and Copilot Studio replay.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Preparing a solution for the seven-step release gate.

aibast_patterns.title: Synthetic-Snapshot Demo Agent
aibast_patterns.summary: Keep portable behavior in one Python file and ground the manual pilot in a fixed synthetic snapshot.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Demonstrating workflow behavior before replacing synthetic inputs with approved sources.

aibast_patterns.title: Copilot Studio Skills and Global Instructions
aibast_patterns.summary: Package routing, knowledge, and SKILL.md procedures with shared privacy, human-review, and side-effect gates.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Rebuilding the packaged agent in Copilot Studio without weakening its reviewed instructions.

aibast_patterns.title: Easy and Manual Mode Workshop Delivery
aibast_patterns.summary: Deliver the same reviewed agent through Copilot-assisted authoring or a literal manual browser build.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Choosing a workshop lane and checking instructions, knowledge, skills, model, and case parity.

aibast_patterns.title: Transcript-Replay Acceptance Testing
aibast_patterns.summary: Replay the canonical persona-language corpus in the target runtime and check source-backed entities and decisions.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Testing routing and behavior before accepting a Draft or changing its implementation.

aibast_patterns.title: No-Terminal Deployment Recipe
aibast_patterns.summary: Describe source retrieval, installation, expected tool, and smoke test in deployment.json.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Letting GitHub Copilot Agent mode install and verify an agent without asking the learner to open a terminal.

aibast_patterns.title: Brainstem to Copilot Studio Tier Promotion
aibast_patterns.summary: Separate local Brainstem, Azure, and Copilot Studio responsibilities in three self-contained tiers.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Choosing a deployment tier after proving local behavior, without treating every tier as mandatory.

aibast_patterns.title: Visual Evidence and Browserfilm Capture
aibast_patterns.summary: Retain real screenshot frames and a manifest to build an auditable walkthrough GIF and contact sheet.
aibast_patterns.applies_to: Capturing workshop evidence without mock screens, customer data, credentials, or unapproved publication.

runbooks_patterns.title: Agent Governance & Rollout Control Plane
runbooks_patterns.summary: Separate workshop evidence from production approval and agreed governance.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Agreeing production connections, governance, telemetry, support, and success measures after a Draft workshop.

runbooks_patterns.title: Agent Publishing & Channel Deployment
runbooks_patterns.summary: Keep a validated Draft separate from the decision to publish.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Planning publication only after replaying the acceptance corpus and receiving explicit human approval.

runbooks_patterns.title: Agentic Workflow Orchestration
runbooks_patterns.summary: Compose multiple agents around a business scenario.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Extending a multi-agent stack such as account intelligence while preserving isolated solution tests.

runbooks_patterns.title: Branded Office Artifact Generation
runbooks_patterns.summary: Preserve source evidence and claim boundaries in delivery artifacts.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Preparing Office deliverables from approved one-pager content without turning synthetic figures into customer claims.

runbooks_patterns.title: Copilot Connector Knowledge Onboarding
runbooks_patterns.summary: Replace synthetic knowledge with approved, least-privilege sources.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Evaluating an indexed knowledge option for the approved HR policy or permit-document replacement seam.

runbooks_patterns.title: Copilot Credits & Cost Control
runbooks_patterns.summary: Review production consumption alongside deployment-tier choices.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Planning Azure or Copilot Studio use beyond the local prototype.

runbooks_patterns.title: Copilot Studio Migration & Modernisation
runbooks_patterns.summary: Preserve the reviewed behavior contract when changing the delivery host.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Adapting a proven agent to Copilot Studio and replaying its canonical cases in the target environment.

runbooks_patterns.title: Copilot Studio & Foundry Split Architecture
runbooks_patterns.summary: Separate local proof, cloud execution, and end-user delivery.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Choosing responsibilities across Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry in the downstream path.

runbooks_patterns.title: Cowork Skill Delivery and Scheduled Reviews
runbooks_patterns.summary: Reuse reviewed instructions and skills without implying acceptance in another host.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Considering Cowork as an additional destination; the packaged skills and Preview evidence here are for Copilot Studio.

runbooks_patterns.title: Declarative vs Custom Engine Agent
runbooks_patterns.summary: Choose a downstream agent surface after proving the intended behavior.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Deciding how to deliver a proven workflow in Copilot Studio or Microsoft 365 Copilot rather than assuming the workshop fixes the agent type.

runbooks_patterns.title: Enterprise RAG Pattern
runbooks_patterns.summary: Keep production retrieval separate from the packaged synthetic snapshot.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Evaluating governed retrieval for approved HR policies or SharePoint permit documents.

runbooks_patterns.title: Governed Analytics Review
runbooks_patterns.summary: Keep analytical decisions traceable to approved evidence and human review.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Replacing synthetic win-loss, client-health, emissions, or utilization inputs without presenting preliminary scores as verified results.

runbooks_patterns.title: Grounding & Response Quality Remediation
runbooks_patterns.summary: Diagnose missing knowledge, inventory mismatch, and missing expected entities before accepting a run.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: A Preview answer fails a locked case or the Easy and Manual inventories differ.

runbooks_patterns.title: Human-in-the-Loop Review & Approval
runbooks_patterns.summary: Separate recommendations and drafts from authorized real-world actions.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Defining approval for HR decisions, permit changes, notifications, or other production writes.

runbooks_patterns.title: Intelligent Document Processing Pipeline
runbooks_patterns.summary: Separate document evidence preparation from the final business decision.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Planning document handling for claims, authorization evidence, or permit intake while preserving the package's approval boundary.

runbooks_patterns.title: MCP Federated Connectors
runbooks_patterns.summary: Treat live retrieval as a future integration rather than a demonstrated connection.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Evaluating a federated option for approved external knowledge; the packaged permit pilot has no live MCP connection.

runbooks_patterns.title: MCP Server Integration
runbooks_patterns.summary: Bind approved live-system tools at the production replacement seam.
runbooks_patterns.applies_to: Choosing a tool interface for approved system access while keeping external writes behind separate governance and human approval.
